comment: Where each screenshot goes (RD-1270-16): deliver.py reads this, capture.mjs the capture settings. A view is a name from views.mjs; every target names the scale its file is taken at. Captions and alt texts name no numbers (alts.json).

by_hand.50-grafana-dashboard: Grafana, not rDownloader; the website's 50-grafana-dashboard.webp is the same view at scale 2
by_hand.51-prometheus-targets: Prometheus, not rDownloader; also the website's 51-prometheus-targets.webp
by_hand.52-prometheus-graph: Prometheus, not rDownloader; also the website's 52-prometheus-graph.webp
by_hand.54-notification-target-jellyfin: needs a reachable Jellyfin server for the destination
by_hand.55-notification-deliveries-media: needs deliveries to real media servers
by_hand.58-color-palettes: a grid composed from every colour theme; the website's 58-color-themes.webp is the same grid at scale 2
by_hand.59-palette-ocean-dark: a colour theme switched by hand
by_hand.60-palette-rose-light: a colour theme switched by hand
by_hand.61-palette-forest-dark: a colour theme switched by hand
by_hand.71-settings-notifications-path-mapping: needs the Plex destination with a reachable Plex server
